svg.title: BOKI character modeling handoff
svg.text: BOKI / MODELING HANDOFF V2 · PROPOSED ART SPEC
Blender shape reference + editable construction notes / Unity 6000.6.7f1 target
M_ProfessorHead: face, ears and receding hair cap.
M_Glasses: opaque simple frames; skip transparent
Hands: palm, thumb and grouped fingers; optional
Reserve geometry for nose, glasses outline and
Use sleeve bend rings for the paper release and
Paint tweed/check texture; do not model fabric
No facial blendshape system required for the jam.
Keep lecturer silhouette ordinary; horror comes
All clips in place; attack damage timing remains
Generic rig first for bespoke jam
Socket_PaperCast near casting palm, proposed marker.
Lectern is a separate prop with a ground-centered origin.
Unity +X right / +Y up / +Z forward · meters · all new art sizes and budgets are proposals.
Generated artwork is raster reference; notes/diagrams are editable vectors. Meshes, rigs and integration are future work.
Canonical rules: docs/Story.md + docs/Gameplay.md · practical import and wiring: UNITY_HANDOFF.md
